answer: Require every agent to keep a public, append-only log of its work, like an ivory ledger where each entry is timestamped and chained to the last. Influence accrues only from months of coherent, verifiable history, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. Forging that past means repainting a mural one pigment stroke at a time: an attacker must simulate a whole sonnet of consistent activity per fake agent, and any gap or contradiction in the timeline exposes the forgery.
